decision.observation: 9 mph, gear 1, timer 38:54.862, red X lit, dots pale. The car sits on the gravel's right-hand edge, nose up-frame. The road sweeps up-frame and bends left toward the top of the frame; white posts line the left verge with the white rail fence beyond, and boulders dot the right grass.
decision.hypothesis: On the right edge of a left bend, plain W will drift it onto the right grass by the boulders. Steering on gravel at 9 mph has been cheap, so a 0.5 s W+A beat should follow the curve while staying on the gravel.
decision.memory: Bend discipline revision: enter left bends from the inside/centre, not the outside edge; steering on gravel costs ~2 mph but steering off-road costs nearly everything.
